High-tech machinery, daytime shifts and plenty of opportunities. A role with perspective, a competitive salary, and the space to develop yourself. Wie zoeken we? You work independently or together with colleagues on assembling and testing complex modules and systems. Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. In addition, you will work in a pleasant, informal environment with opportunities for team activities. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle th

build independently or together with one or two colleagues. While some standard machines are delivered, no two machines are ever the same since each one is fully customized to the client’s specifications. Once you know the machines inside out you will also perform the final testing and prepare the accompanying test reports, making sure the machines deliver exactly as promised. You will join an innovative company in the semiconductor industry, based in Nijmegen. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.

You’ll join a team full of expertise, but also one that gives you the space to grow.
